newsitem.title: TURKEY: Ford-Koc Turkish venture to change name.
newsitem.headline: Ford-Koc Turkish venture to change name.

text.p: Turkish motor vehicle producer Otosan Otomobil Sanayii AS, a joint venture of Ford Motor Co and Turkish Koc group said it planned to change its name to Ford Otomotiv Sanayi AS (Ford Otosan).

Changes in Otosan's statute will be reviewed and voted on at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on July 24 as part of a deal between Koc and Ford to equalise their holdings and management responsibilities in Otosan.
Ford announced on June 30 that it will raise its stake to 41 percent from 30 by buying shares from Koc group companies and Koc family members.

Otosan said company shares would be split into three groups: A series publicly owned shares traded on the Istanbul stock exchange, B series belonging to Koc group and C series to Ford and not traded on the exchange.
Otosan's management board will include four members each from Ford and Koc, after the statute changes are approved on July 24.
Otosan produces Ford Escort small car and Ford Cargo and Ford Transit commercial trucks.
